scope: Pre-authoring protocol/source consistency review. This is not an inference release, publication approval, or an independent recount of outputs.

reviewer.model_metadata_source: Parent task instructions report verified inherited session metadata; no model override was requested.
reviewer.context_declaration: The initial reviewer task began with fresh task context and no cases or labels. This follow-up retains only the assigned review instructions, earlier permitted protocol/rubric versions, my review findings, coordinator messages and the permitted source texts. I am not either initial annotator or the inference process.

resolved.resolution: The protocol pins ai_e2_bank.py, RNG order, category/subtype allocation, normalization, set-bigram similarity, thresholds and first-passing selection.

resolved.issue: Frozen comparison corpora and bounded generation
resolved.resolution: screen now checks frozen absolute-path/hash membership and 100/48 text counts, enforces rounds 1 through 5, and detects case-insensitive category tokens while rejecting noncanonical or unknown IDs.

The protocol preserves independently finalized originals, aborts malformed/incompatible versions before inference, specifies final command forms and reference-derived ranking semantics, and fixes agreement alignment, bootstrap choices and the eleven-test BH family.

The worker checks exact release fields, four source-path keys, six-file bundle inventory, fixed bundle input filenames, source hashes, runtime/options, timeout and no-bytecode policy before question loading. Denied protected-path probes and network/file audit checks remain application-level protections over trusted code.
Exclusive durable attempt and terminal-output writes, a global opening marker, a new output directory, aborted interrupted versions and complete 200-record prediction coverage are specified.
The role custodian prompt now permits only denied probe path strings outside allowed roots and forbids reference contents and probe paths in the Ollama payload.

findings.pre_authoring_result: No remaining concrete blocker identified in the reviewed protocol, bank and worker versions.
publication_and_inference_limits: Exact corpus contents, historical evidence, E1 inputs, baseline semantic parser/evaluator sources, model files and runtime state were outside this permitted review; actual freeze manifests and verification receipts must pin and validate them as specified.

The freezer and scoring wrapper were read for consistency and reference-join ordering. This receipt does not independently verify the underlying ranking, statistical or relevance arithmetic. The planned pre-inference wrapper review and post-commit output recount remain required.
Procedural AI context separation does not provide independent training or human ground truth. Application audit hooks are not an OS sandbox or a defense against a compromised host or administrator.
The coordinator reported that no formal cases exist. I did not enumerate the filesystem to verify their absence.

verification.reviewer_actions: Static reading and SHA-256 hashing of only the permitted files; no bank generation, annotation, inference, or test execution by this reviewer.
verification.boundary_test: Coordinator reported a passed no-case subprocess test. I inspected test_ai_e2_boundary.py but did not independently execute the test or read its result artifact.
verification.required_before_authoring: Create the protocol freeze receipt with these reviewed versions, the actual exclusion/input/source hashes, no-case preflight evidence and available agent/runtime identity. The coordinator must check this verdict and exact hash correspondence before invoking the freezer.
verification.required_before_inference: Complete the specified bank/reference locks, semantic-wrapper review and full immutable release. Commit/hash terminal predictions before any scoring join.
